.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/task/tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual}/judge.toml ([judge]/[scoring] blocks in full; criterion descriptions searched for cross-criterion stop/skip/dependency wording, not all read line by line)
evidence: All three scored dimensions are mode = "batched" with aggregation = "weighted_mean" (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:3,21; polish/judge.toml:3,15; visual/judge.toml:3,15) and each prompt carries the required instruction. functional/prompt.md:11 "Score each criterion independently and continue after any failure; return a verdict for every criterion. A failed criterion never ends the session.", reinforced by :10 "Never carry a verdict across criteria ... a failure in one must not fail another whose own steps passed" and :26 "give every criterion its own verdict". polish/prompt.md:10 has the same sentence, plus :11 "Never carry a verdict across criteria ... Attempt every criterion". visual/prompt.md:13 "Score each criterion independently and continue after any low score; return a score for every criterion. Give every criterion its own observation and never carry a score across criteria." (likert-appropriate wording). No stop-at-first-failure instruction exists: the only 'stop' wording is criterion-scoped, functional/prompt.md:15 "Fail fast: after two failed attempts at the same control or step, stop and fail that criterion, then continue with the rest", which mirrors the frozen template (template functional/prompt.md:28). Tool-error rules also continue (functional:27, polish:20, visual:21 "... and move on"). The one all-or-nothing rule, the in-dimension global browser gate at line 5 of each prompt ("If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension"), is template-mandated (template scored prompts; staged-task-contract.md:156) and is a precondition, not a per-criterion cascade. app_context.md:29 supports independence under a broken Run ("Criteria that do not depend on Run are still scored on their own steps"). A search of the 42 functional, 6 polish and 3 visual criterion descriptions for skip/depends-on/other-criterion wording found only scope disclaimers ("scored elsewhere, not here"), no criterion that inherits another's verdict. Gate dimensions (all_pass) are exempt. Broken-app probe: an app with dead Run fails Run-dependent criteria but the prompts direct continued scoring of editor/persistence criteria. Conforming-alternative probe: nothing in the wording lets one miss zero an unrelated criterion. Limits: this is a source-wording finding; the private check-batched-independence-wording.py was not executed, and no configured judge run exists for these bytes (the hosted run on an earlier candidate scored Functional 41/41, so it never exercised continuation after a failure). Whether the judge model actually obeys the instruction is unmeasured, but the row asks for the prompt wording, which is present.
